name: Short Course - PUT Courses API Unavailable
description: POST ZSC00001 → approve → PUT bundles ZSC00001 unchanged alongside a brand-new course, ZSC00500 (the das-commitments-stubs Courses API stub's hardcoded 500 code) — a genuine Progression-via-PUT scenario (see progression-multi-put), not an artificial one: CourseCode is immutable for an already-existing episode, but a PUT can legitimately introduce a new course code for the first time, and that new code goes through the same Courses API lookup a POST would. UpdateShortCourseLearningCommandHandler.Handle looks up EVERY OnProgramme item's course code via the Courses API on every PUT, unconditionally, via Task.WhenAll, before ever calling the Learning inner API. ShortCourseLookupService retries ZSC00500's 500 three times (Polly, exponential backoff ~2s/4s/8s) then throws CoursesApiUnavailableException for that one item — but because the lookups run as a single WhenAll batch, the exception aborts the whole PUT, so ZSC00001's (perfectly valid, unrelated) update in the same request is lost too. ShortCoursesController maps the exception to a 503. Expect this step to take roughly 14+ seconds before it returns. Asserts the captured status code is 503.

steps.name: SLD PUTs ZSC00001 (unchanged) + a New Progression Course while the Courses API is down
